profile.name: 远程电子显微镜控制代理
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件控制组件，通过远程显微镜服务器连接电子显微镜。它用于读取 TEM/STEM 状态，调节束流、像移、倍率与工作模式，管理相机和探测器参数，并触发图像或信号采集。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software proxy that connects to an electron microscope through a remote microscope server. It is used to read TEM/STEM status, adjust beam, image, magnification, and operating modes, manage camera and detector parameters, and trigger image or signal acquisition.

registry.name: Remote Microscope
registry.description: Remote Microscope Controller 光学显微镜是一款普通光学显微镜，主要功能包括成像、打开、状态查询、电压读取、聚焦、采集。支持Signal, Slot, get beam blanked等操作。
